title: Vikings QB Kyler Murray ruled out for Week 2 matchup vs. Bears while in concussion protocol

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Vikings QB Kyler Murray ruled out for Week 2 matchup vs. Bears while in concussion protocol
sources.description: Minnesota coach Kevin O'Connell said Friday that he expects Murray, who left the team's Week 1 win over the Packers after sustaining a scary hit, to be cleared 'early next week.'
